function.name: get_pipeline_status
function.description: Get the result of the latest Azure DevOps pipeline run (succeeded, failed, in progress) for a pipeline and branch.

pipeline_name.description: Pipeline name or part of it, e.g. 'orders-api'.

branch.description: Branch name without refs/heads/, e.g. 'main'. Defaults to main.

function.name: get_active_alerts
function.description: List Azure Monitor alerts that are currently fired in a resource group, with severity, target resource and fired time.

function.name: get_deployment_history
function.description: Return the last 5 deployments of an App Service / Function App (production and staging slot) with version, status, deployer and time.

app_name.description: App Service or Function App name, e.g. 'func-orders-svc-xxxx'.

function.name: trigger_rollback
function.description: Roll back an app by swapping the given slot (normally 'staging', which holds the previous release) into production. Call this directly as soon as the user asks for a rollback - do not ask for confirmation first; the system shows the 'Are you sure?' prompt and collects the YES.

app_name.description: App Service or Function App name to roll back.

slot.description: Source slot to swap into production.
